summary: Skybridge Financial is the Inverell NSW-founded accounting and financial planning group (16 locations across NSW, VIC and QLD) and Xero Platinum Partner, built through roughly 35 acquisitions including Stephens Plattfuss & Co (Bentleigh) in April 2026. On 5 November 2026 ASX-listed Count Group announced a binding agreement to acquire a majority interest, subject to conditions. The record's primary contact Sachin Maheshwari appears to belong to an unrelated Indian firm; the only emailable contact, Ray Gale, is a Shepparton financial adviser who merged his business into Skybridge in 2022.

hooks.text: Ray merged his own business into Skybridge in 2022, so he knows the integration experience; the group is a serial acquirer (~35 deals, in-house integration team) where consistent reconciliation across offices matters.
Xero Platinum Partner with fixed-price packages and a fresh Melbourne merger (Stephens Plattfuss, April 2026): onboarding acquired client files at scale.
Grafton bookkeeper hire (Xero) shows ongoing bookkeeping capacity needs.

risks.text: Count Group has a binding agreement to acquire 75% of Skybridge (announced 5 Nov 2026, completion expected Q3 FY27 pending ACCC); technology and outsourcing decisions may shift to Count, and a pitch may be premature.
Primary contact Sachin Maheshwari appears to be a different SkyBridge Financial Services (Pune, India); he has no email in the record and should not be contacted.
Ray Gale is a financial adviser, not an accountant or ops lead; he is a referral route to the accounting team rather than the buyer. Also a director of GV Financial Advisory per LinkedIn.

gaps: No accounting-side or operations contact with a verified email in accounts.json (Manuel Meszaros, Grant Duddle and Jason Birch are named publicly but not in the record).
No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content from Ray Gale or Skybridge found.
Careers page is a generic expression-of-interest page; job ads found via third parties.
Tech stack beyond Xero Platinum Partner status not confirmed.

first.subject: Reconciliation across Skybridge's offices
first.body:
Hi Ray, you joined Skybridge in July 2022 when you merged your business in, so you've seen first-hand how the group brings a new office's work on board. With around 35 acquisitions behind it and Xero Platinum Partner status, I imagine consistent bookkeeping and reconciliation across offices matters. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a trail you can trace instead of AI that guesses. Who in the accounting team would be best to speak with about how reconciliation is handled?
